visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy wearing glasses and a white collared shirt stands alongside a woman with reddish-brown hair in a peach-colored blouse. They are positioned in front of a clean white tiled wall. The boy is holding a microphone stand and waving enthusiastically. (2) The setting shifts slightly to show the woman sitting at a brown upright piano while the boy stands next to her, actively speaking into the microphone with expressive hand gestures. The lighting is bright and consistent across the studio environment. (3) The boy begins to sing with a focused facial expression, while the woman plays the piano accompaniment. Visual cutaways of natural scenery, including crashing ocean waves on a sandy beach and a mountain skyline at sunset, are interspersed with the performance. (4) The boy holds a sheet of paper containing lyrics and continues his vocal performance. Text overlays with song titles and poetic descriptions appear on the screen as the woman maintains a smiling and supportive demeanor while playing.
